text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace won the Kikuka Sho. That 
victory lit a flame of courage in the 
hearts of her friends... and Sheina 
Frejus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the cheers rained down upon Mr. 
C.B. Society's "common sense" that "Mr. 
C.B. is the strongest" could not be 
overturned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can see that Katsuragi Ace is at 
the top. They wanted to build a track 
record that would make the world believe 
it, too. And so, the two set their sights 
on becoming the 'Strongest at Medium 
Distance.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, soon after... News arrived that 
Mr. C.B. was taking a break. Katsuragi Ace 
was left disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, with rivals absent now, Katsuragi 
Ace resolved to make her presence known. 
She took her first steps toward the Osaka 
Hai!
